## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL regime. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; confirmed by mixed sector leadership (Healthcare, Consumer Staples, Utilities outperforming vs Technology, Materials lagging) and major mega-cap divergences where several large-cap techs are BELOW TREND while Healthcare names are ABOVE TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Healthcare leads: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.77% | 1M: +12.01%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +9.15%), ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.56% | 1M: +16.32%). Consumer Staples showing resilience: KHC ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.80% | 1M: +0.65%). Communication strength from CHTR in RECOVERY (1W: +16.43% | 1M: -0.74%). 

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Materials weak: DOW BELOW TREND (1W: -9.32% | 1M: -18.88%), FCX BELOW TREND (1W: -10.97% | 1M: -6.45%). Technology soft with concentration of losers: ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -15.60% | 1M: -27.46%), QCOM BELOW TREND (1W: -14.95% | 1M: -22.14%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -9.85%). Financials mixed to weak: BLK BELOW TREND (1W: -9.66% | 1M: -8.69%), CME BELOW TREND (1W: -10.86% | 1M: -20.80%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: CHTR RECOVERY (1W: +16.43% | 1M: -0.74%), PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.92% | 1M: +28.80%), MRK ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.04% | 1M: +8.69%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.77% | 1M: +12.01%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +9.15%). Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Healthcare).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: GS CORRECTION (1W: -7.79% | 1M: +1.62%), TJX BELOW TREND (1W: -7.88% | 1M: -2.36%), DOW BELOW TREND (1W: -9.32% | 1M: -18.88%), BLK BELOW TREND (1W: -9.66% | 1M: -8.69%), CME BELOW TREND (1W: -10.86% | 1M: -20.80%). Weakness concentrated in Financials and Materials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W momentum: CHTR (1W: +16.43% | 1M: -0.74%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +15.92% | 1M: +28.80%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.04% | 1M: +8.69%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR DIVERGENCE among megacaps—MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +0.33% | 1M: -13.68%), AMZN RECOVERY (1W: +3.16% | 1M: -12.36%), GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +1.14% | 1M: -9.30%) — implies tactical opportunities, not confirmation for a broad regime shift.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed with short-term bifurcation: PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.92% | 1M: +28.80%) and IBM ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +5.22%) versus large-cap weakness AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -9.85%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -6.56% | 1M: -8.89%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -15.60% | 1M: -27.46%).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Mixed/rotational: V ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +5.14%), MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +3.22%) show strength while GS CORRECTION (1W: -7.79% | 1M: +1.62%), BLK BELOW TREND (1W: -9.66% | 1M: -8.69%), CME BELOW TREND (1W: -10.86% | 1M: -20.80%) reflect dispersion.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Clear leadership: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.77% | 1M: +12.01%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +9.15%), ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.56% | 1M: +16.32%), MRK ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.04% | 1M: +8.69%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.23% | 1M: +10.38%).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Given NEUTRAL regime and concentrated Healthcare leadership, favor increasing exposure to Healthcare and selective Industrials while reducing exposure to mega-cap Tech names showing BELOW TREND; style: mixed / no clear leadership. Monitor the major megacap divergences before making broad allocation changes.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.92% | 1M: +28.80%), JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.77% | 1M: +12.01%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +9.15%). BEARISH: ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -15.60% | 1M: -27.46%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -9.85%), QCOM BELOW TREND (1W: -14.95% | 1M: -22.14%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +6.04% | 1M: +5.79%; 17 stocks) and Consumer Staples (1W: +2.61% | 1M: +0.58%; 14 stocks). BEARISH: Technology (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -3.13%; 24 stocks) and Materials (1W: -3.08% | 1M: -2.22%; 11 stocks).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch PANW: follow-through above this week's surge to confirm durable breakout; NVDA: failure to regain weekly range argues for continued tech pressure; AAPL: break below recent 1W lows would reinforce BELOW TREND dynamics and widen leadership divergence.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
ABBV (+80): ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.56% | 1M: +16.32%) — news on RINVOQ uses confirms price strength. MA (+75): MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +3.22%) — legal settlement progress confirmed by rally. BA (+55): BA BELOW TREND (1W: -2.78% | 1M: -6.16%) — bullish China deal but price is not confirming, watch for follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
ORCL (-50): ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -15.60% | 1M: -27.46%) — negative headlines confirm distribution. AAPL (-45): AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -9.85%) — news-driven weakness confirmed. META (-45): META BELOW TREND (1W: -0.22% | 1M: -11.36%) — regulatory headlines align with price softening. CME (-45): CME BELOW TREND (1W: -10.86% | 1M: -20.80%) — target cuts confirm downside pressure.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, breadth 6/11 sectors positive and style mixed / no clear leadership.  
Healthcare names are showing relative strength — JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.77% | 1M: +12.01%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +9.15%), ABBV ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.56% | 1M: +16.32%).  
Key risk is concentrated mega-cap tech divergence (AAPL, NVDA, ORCL BELOW TREND) and sentiment-driven moves in ORCL/AAPL that could widen market dispersion — watch for trend confirmation before extending positions.
